name: charter
title: Charter - Chart and Diagram Catalog
description: Browse chart and diagram types with Mermaid, shadcn and ECharts examples, docs and prompt snippets, and draw Mermaid and ECharts on your Mac
author: aic

commands.name: browse-charts
commands.title: Browse Charts
commands.subtitle: Charter
commands.description: Browse chart and diagram types by family through a Mermaid, shadcn or ECharts lens, and copy the docs link, example or prompt snippet

commands.name: render-chart
commands.title: Render Chart
commands.subtitle: Charter
commands.description: Draw a Mermaid diagram or an Apache ECharts option from the selection, the clipboard or a pasted source, then copy or save the picture

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Browser
preferences.description: A Chromium-based browser that draws the charts. Leave empty to use Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Arc or Microsoft Edge, whichever is installed.

preferences.name: krokiUrl
preferences.title: Kroki Server
preferences.description: Draws Mermaid diagrams when no browser is found, and only when you ask. Point it at your own Kroki to keep diagrams off the public server.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
